title: A rectangle filled with a linear gradient
concept: A <Gradient> swatch with two <GradientStop>s, applied to a shape by FillColor.

annotations.note: A Gradient swatch. Type=Linear (the other value is Radial); its Self id is what a shape's FillColor points at. The blend is defined entirely by its child GradientStop elements.

Each GradientStop references a Color by StopColor and places it with Location, a percentage 0..100 along the gradient. Midpoint (13..87) biases where the halfway blend sits between this stop and the next.
The two stop colors. A gradient holds no color of its own; it only references existing <Color> swatches by their Self id.
